verdict.rationale: Fenwick runs a public Startup Resource Center that offers articles, videos, checklists and presentations spanning formation to exit. It includes specific guides on incorporation-stage issues, seed financings, and equity vesting, which together cover formation, financing and equity. missing for 10: confirmation that the guides are openly accessible rather than gated behind the '/form' page, evidence of FAQ-style or plain-language explainer depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: Our startup resource center features articles, videos, checklists, presentations and other tools to help you navigate current challenges and anticipate upcoming issues at every stage of growth, from formation to scaling to preparing for exit.
Incorporation Stage Issues and Seed Financings Overview — Common issues startup founders face at incorporation, plus considerations and possible structures for seed financings.
Put appropriate equity vesting in place, protect your intellectual property, comply with employment laws and other helpful tips.
